description: This file contains shell script functions related to platform-specific upgrade procedures for a Linux-based embedded device, specifically for bcm27xx architecture. It includes functions for checking images, performing upgrades, and copying configurations, utilizing external scripts and command-line tools.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks if the provided image is compatible by comparing partition layouts.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the upgrade process, writing image data to specified disk and partition devices.

methods.name: bcm27xx_set_root_part
methods.description: Sets the root partition UUID in boot configuration based on a stored UUID or default device.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies configuration files from a backup archive to the mounted boot partition, handles mounting and unmounting.

methods.name: platform_restore_backup
methods.description: Restores backup configuration files from an archive.
